generator: BEAM generator (https://github.com/mohammadtavakoli78/BEAM at b2da22e), run in custody by eval/custody/rs1/mint.sh
layout: conversations/c<NNN>/beam/1/chat.json (chat_trunecated.json when present) and conversations/c<NNN>/beam/1/probing_questions/probing_questions.json under GBRAIN_EVALS_RS1_SOURCE (mint.sh's <out>/set); conversation rs1-<NNN> is conversations/c<NNN>, NNN = 001 to 048 (48 mint slots, minted in slot order)
note: Hashes only; no RS1 text is committed. Until the custodian fills it on the custody host, `files` is empty and beam-rs1 loads with a notice that its bytes are unpinned. Once filled, every file the loader reads must be listed here with a matching SHA-256, and every listed file of a loaded conversation must be present. A filled manifest also lists `kept`, the kept conversations in slot order (the first slots that passed validation; wave A is the first 20), and `n_final` once the pilot sets it; RS1 cells run on that list alone. A refill only adds files and records the earlier fill's sha256 under `earlier_fills` (docs/benchmarks/2026-11-08-rs1-narrow-preregistration.md).
